description: Na₃CoO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnm space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.88 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.35 Å. Co is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.96 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom.
